title: Act: Add the current-Round ExecutionInfo lookup
description: Add a pure filter helper and an async wrapper in client.ts that uses getCurrentRound and listExecutions.
acceptance_criteria: findExecutionForRound returns the newest matching execution or undefined
getCurrentRoundExecution resolves the current round id then returns its execution

steps.action: Add exported pure function findExecutionForRound(list: ExecutionInfo[], roundId: string): ExecutionInfo | undefined that filters by round_id === roundId and returns the entry with the greatest updated_at string, or undefined when none match.
steps.expected: Returns newest matching execution or undefined

steps.action: Add exported async function getCurrentRoundExecution(token: string, worldId: string = WORLD_ID) that awaits getCurrentRound(worldId) and listExecutions(token), then returns findExecutionForRound(list, round.id).
steps.expected: Resolves to the current Round's ExecutionInfo or undefined
